plans.scenario: Connexion échouée avec email non enregistré

actions.action: Precede the action with an explicit expectation: await expect(page.locator("getByLabel("Mot de passe").fill("123456789")")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15000 });
Prefer response-driven waits (waitForResponse) over bare waits for AJAX content.
Raise the action timeout from the default instead of relying on the test-level timeout.

explanation: The wait timed out but the error gives no proof the element is missing.
The element likely appears later than the default wait allows, so a targeted wait strategy replaces the guesswork.

plans.scenario: Connexion échouée avec mot de passe incorrect

actions.action: Use the verified single-element selector "input[name="email"]" from the knowledge base.

explanation: The locator resolved to multiple elements (strict mode violation).
A more specific verified selector exists: input[name="email"].
